notes: Base multiplayer final scoring; supply quantities exclude machinery on the wheel. Objective VP remains manually awarded with split ties rounded up. Leeghwater adds final VP printed on activated Private Buildings, entered separately; immediate advanced-technology VP already belongs on the track. Solo/automa, Duel/new maps and five-player modules not automated.
